disposition_reason: Lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury were measured in 927 market samples of eight fruits in Korea, with mean and range per fruit in Table 6.

study.design: National market monitoring survey (KFDA) of 8 fruits, 4 domestic and 4 imported
study.origin: domestic Korean and imported fruits (which are imported not itemised)
study.market: major production-area agricultural wholesale markets across Seoul, Gyeonggi, Gangwon, Chungcheong, Gyeongsang, Jeolla and Jeju, Korea
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion, ICP-MS (Pb, Cd, As); direct mercury analyzer DMA-80 (Hg)
lod: LOD Pb 0.007, Cd 0.0014, As 0.02, Hg 0.03 µg/kg; LOQ Pb 0.02, Cd 0.004, As 0.05, Hg 0.1 µg/kg
study.qa: Standard addition recoveries 81-111% (Pb, Cd, As); CRMs KRISS rice flour (Pb 90.0%, Cd 90.3%, As 110.6%), ERM-BC084a tomato paste (Pb 90.0%, Cd 83.4%), MESS-3 marine sediment Hg 106.5%
